title: Rabbah bar Maryon
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Eruvin 19a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.19a.15), Rabbah bar Maryon recited a baraita in the school of Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai. [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Eruvin.19a.15.1) explains that the baraita had been arranged in his study house. In [Sukkah 32b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.32b.2), Rabbah bar Mari recited the teaching in the name of Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai.[^1]

notes.text: Eruvin’s consulted text has “in the school of Rabbi Yochanan ben Zakkai,” whereas Hyman gives ברבי and the title Rabban. Both passages have an alternative transmission through Rabbi Maryon in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3155&lang=en) quotes Rashi’s study-house explanation.
